incidents.name: RWAVault
incidents.notes: RWAVault overrode ERC4626 withdraw() without the allowance spend when msg.sender!=owner, letting the attacker withdraw eight depositors' balances.

sources.ref: Onchain review: RWAVault 0x317aa10528ff675ef4c358ea6a5b7b5494325733 created 2026-02-04T04:32:59Z (block 24381124) by 0x81868cc83622b722a0c9fd423f6c66b4ddd800e9, not the attack-tx sender 0x7137804200a073f616d92e87007f1f100100b56a. keccak(eth_getCode) is identical at the creation and incident blocks, no EIP-1967/beacon/implementation slot is set (storage slots 0-25 are all zero), and the exploit trace contains no DELEGATECALL out of the victim; the only 0xf4 byte in the runtime sits inside trailing constant data rather than reachable code. Deployment basis is exact.
